_comment: Schema for review/result.json. See SKILL.md for details.

summary.change_intent: what the PR appears to do

findings._location_rule: ⚠️ MANDATORY: Every finding MUST have a valid location. Format: 'file:line' (e.g. src/foo.py:42) or 'file:start-end' (e.g. src/utils.py:10-25). Empty, unknown, N/A, or vague values are FORBIDDEN. Only architecture/documentation issues may use '(architecture)' or '(documentation)' with explanation in issue field.

must_fix.dimension: Code or Clean or Spec or Security or Performance (optional; matches comment tag)
must_fix.location: REQUIRED: file:line (e.g. src/foo.py:42) - MUST be precise line number, not empty/unknown/vague

comment.title: short PR inline comment title; defaults to issue first line
comment.scenario: specific trigger condition or input that exposes the issue
comment.fix: specific repair direction; defaults to recommendation
comment.verification: test or manual verification expected after the fix
comment.code: optional code snippet or diff for the PR comment

should_fix.dimension: Code or Clean or Spec or Security or Performance (optional)
should_fix.location: REQUIRED: file:line (e.g. src/foo.py:42) - MUST be precise line number, not empty/unknown/vague

comment.title: short PR inline comment title; defaults to issue first line
comment.scenario: specific trigger condition or maintainability scenario
comment.impact: why it matters if deferred; defaults to risk
comment.fix: specific improvement direction; defaults to recommendation
comment.verification: test or manual verification expected after the change
comment.code: optional code snippet or diff for the PR comment
